subject: Campus France service fee
description: The service page and tariff grid report different service fees.
business_risk: The chatbot could quote an incorrect fee.
recommended_action: Obtain written confirmation from Moov Money and update the validated tariff record.

subject: General contact email
description: The footer displays contact@moovmoney.ga while another email address appears on the Contact page.
value_b: Other address displayed on the Contact page
business_risk: Users may be directed to an outdated or incorrect mailbox.
recommended_action: Confirm the official customer-support email before production.

subject: Contact details
description: The collected Contact page record indicates that contact details vary between sections of the website.
recommended_action: Validate the official phone number, email and address with Moov Money.

subject: Tariff grid typography
description: The tariff page is marked as containing typographical anomalies.
business_risk: A formatting error may be interpreted as a fee or threshold.
recommended_action: Perform a line-by-line business validation of all tariff brackets.

subject: Derived Q&A and intents
description: Some chatbot questions and intent examples are derived from official pages and are not themselves published FAQs.
business_risk: Derived wording may need tone and intent-label review.
recommended_action: Have customer service validate the generated questions, answers and intent names.
